en-US.name: PodBot
en-US.summary: Plays the latest Morning Brew Daily and answers what-you-just-heard.
en-US.description: PodBot plays the newest Morning Brew Daily episode and can answer questions about what was just said by analyzing the last ~75 seconds of audio with Gemini.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask pod bot to play Morning Brew
Alexa, ask pod bot what is compute
Alexa, ask pod bot what did I just miss

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Try: 'Alexa, ask pod bot to play Morning Brew', then 'what did I just miss?'.
